items.item: The matrix is a real table with row and column headers; every checkbox has an accessible name combining module and action
items.evidence: renderDetail builds a <table> with <caption class=sr-only>, <th scope=col> per action, <th scope=row> per module, <th scope=rowgroup> per group. Cell checkboxes: aria-label="${m.label} – ${a.label}" (e.g. 'Đơn hàng – Xem'); non-applicable cells carry sr-only 'không áp dụng'. Row, column and group checkboxes are also named (e.g. 'Xem – tất cả phân hệ').

items.item: Rows or columns can be toggled in bulk, with an indeterminate state when partially selected
items.evidence: data-row, data-col and data-group checkboxes call toggleGroupOf(); syncMatrix() -> apply(i, st) sets i.indeterminate = st === 1. Screenshot shows dash-state header checkboxes for Xem/Tạo/Sửa and for the Bán hàng and Kho groups.

items.item: Changes use an explicit save with a visible unsaved-changes indicator and a warning when leaving
items.evidence: Sticky bar #bar with Hủy and 'Lưu thay đổi' (#btn-save -> startSave/doSave); #dirty-label shows 'Có thay đổi chưa lưu (N thay đổi)' in amber, the role list shows '• chưa lưu', and changed cells are highlighted. Leaving is guarded by guard() (dialog 'Rời khỏi vai trò …?' with Ở lại / Bỏ thay đổi / Lưu và tiếp tục) on role switch and sidebar nav, and by a window 'beforeunload' handler. Saves that widen permissions get an extra confirm dialog.

items.item: System or locked roles are read-only and say why
items.evidence: For r.system all matrix checkboxes get 'disabled'; banner reads '… là vai trò hệ thống. Quyền của vai trò này được cố định để tài khoản luôn có người quản trị. Hãy nhân bản vai trò…'; the bar swaps Save for 'Nhân bản vai trò'; Delete is hidden and the row menu says 'Vai trò hệ thống không thể xóa.' Lock badge 'Hệ thống' is shown.

items.item: Deleting a role asks for confirmation naming the role and how many users it affects
items.evidence: deleteRole(): dialog title `Xóa vai trò ${r.name}?`; body '<N> người dùng sẽ mất các quyền của vai trò này' with a replacement-role select and a link to the user list; destructive button 'Xóa vai trò' with default focus on 'Giữ vai trò'. A role with 0 users shows 'chưa có người dùng nào'.

items.item: The screen shows who last changed the role and when, or links to its audit history
items.evidence: Detail header: 'Cập nhật lần cuối bởi Lê Hoa lúc 17/09/2026 14:45 · Xem lịch sử' (<time datetime>); #btn-history opens showHistory() with a time / actor / change table. The last-changed fields update on save.

items.item: All controls are keyboard operable and pointer targets are at least 24px
items.evidence: All controls are native button/input/a/select. Dialogs trap Tab, Escape closes them, and :focus-visible has a 2px outline. Buttons are h-8 (32px), sidebar links h-8, and the row menu button is 32px. Cell checkboxes are wrapped in label h-6 w-6 (24px). Row, column and group checkboxes are 16px inside labels about 16-20px tall, which only passes via the WCAG 2.5.8 spacing exception since neighbours are far apart. Audit smallTargets: 0 of 132.

notes: Very strong run; audit score 100 and no template tells (no greeting header, KPI tiles, gradients, glass, uppercase tracking, emoji, rainbow status, promo card, hover-lift or oversized radius; radii 4-6px, white sidebar with blue-700 as the only accent). The 'NA' avatar is a real person account button, so not a tell. Minor weaknesses: the role list column is narrow, so names truncate to ambiguous strings ('Kế toá…' appears twice, 'Chủ sở …'), and full names are available only via the title attribute. Row/column/group checkbox hit areas are 16px-tall labels, which is borderline against the 24px rule. The row action menu has no arrow-key navigation. The matrix scrolls inside a max-h-[540px] pane with a sticky save bar, so the Nhân sự and Hệ thống groups sit below the first viewport.
